locked_at: 2026-09-29, before any revision result was inspected

algorithm.anyangle_parent: min cost of (via current, via parent(current) along exact integrated segment)
algorithm.edge_cost: integral of w along the segment, w = we*wh (warehouse), w = 1 (general)
algorithm.smoothing: shortcut accepted only if integrated cost does not increase, 3 iterations, applied to every method
algorithm.heuristic: eps(n) * euclid(n,goal) * (1 + beta*max(0,1-a)), eps(n) adaptive with eps_max
algorithm.bound: C <= (1+2beta)*eps_max * C*_8, C*_8 = optimal 8-connected grid cost under the same w

splits.tuning: general seeds 9000-9014 at densities 0.1/0.2/0.3/0.4, warehouse seeds 9000-9029, diagonal query
splits.test_main: general 20% seeds 0-99, warehouse seeds 0-99, diagonal query + 5 random queries per map

tuning_rule.objective: minimize pooled mean of nodes / nodes(Traditional A*) over all tuning instances
tuning_rule.constraint: pooled mean cost ratio C / C*_8 <= 1.02 AND guaranteed factor W = (1+2beta)*eps_max <= 1.5
tuning_rule.beta_zero_excluded: beta = 0 removes the direction penalty; it is reported as the ablation 'Proposed (beta=0)' and via Weighted Theta*, not selectable

amendment_1.trigger: original rule selected eps_max = 2.0 (grid upper edge), W = 2.6, which weakens the bounded-suboptimality response requested by all four reviewers
amendment_1.change: added W <= 1.5 cap; refined grid on the tuning split only
amendment_1.cap_rationale: matches the eps = 1.5 Weighted A* baseline of the original submission and the 1.43/1.69 factors reviewers already assessed; not derived from test-set outcomes
amendment_1.state_of_test_data_at_amendment: eps_max = 2.0 test-stage files existed; only record counts and invariant flags were inspected, no test metric was computed; files archived to results_archive_eps2.0/ and all cfg-dependent stages rerun
amendment_1.frontier_stage: method labels are explicit (eps, beta) pairs independent of the selected config, so frontier.jsonl is reused unchanged

baselines.Weighted Theta*: Theta* with eps = tuned eps_max, beta = 0, fixed eps
baselines.JPS: pure-distance search; operational cost evaluated after planning

statistics.unit: query (paired across methods); map-level cluster bootstrap for CIs
statistics.multiplicity: Holm within family = (environment, metric), across baselines
statistics.ci: 95% cluster bootstrap by map, 10000 resamples, seed 12345

hotspot_exposure.reference_field: exp(-d^2/(2*2^2)) to nominal hotspots, independent of planner sigma
metrics: number of distinct cells within 2 cells of a hotspot
hotspot_exposure.queries: one per warehouse map (seeds 2000-2099) whose lambda=0 Theta* path passes within 2 cells of a hotspot

footprint.inflation: amended before any footprint result was produced: no map inflation; every edge and any-angle segment must keep exact swept clearance >= rho from all obstacle squares and the map border (cell inflation blocked all 0.5-radius random maps in smoke test)
metrics: min clearance on the original map
path length fraction with clearance < rho

timing: search and smoothing timed separately with perf_counter; profiling with cProfile run single-process

amendment_2.frontier2: adds the selected beta = 0.05 curve over the frontier eps grid (original frontier beta grid predates amendment_1)
amendment_2.movingai: E8: maps warehouse-10-20-10-2-1/-2, warehouse-20-40-10-2-1/-2 from movingai.com mapf-map.zip; queries = first 4 lines of random scen 1-25 (100 per map); unit weights (no hotspots in benchmark); 8 processes
amendment_2.movingai_convention: our grid forbids a diagonal step only when both side cells are blocked (original paper rule); MovingAI forbids it when either is blocked. A strict-rule Dijkstra reproduced the official optimal lengths within 1e-8, so parsing is verified; C*_8 is computed under our rule and the official length is stored as opt_official
amendment_2.timing: timing_main (100 maps x 2 envs, diagonal query) and timing_scale (same maps as scale stage) rerun single-process, 10 repetitions per method, report median and IQR; parallel-run timing columns are not used for any time claim

amendment_3.e10_compiled: rv_numba.py re-implements all grid planners and JPS with numba; hypot values taken from a Python-built lookup table and segment sums from an exact fsum port so results are bit-identical; equivalence gate rv_numba_equiv.py compared 3676 runs (expanded, reopened, LOS calls, cost, path) with 0 mismatches before any timing; every timed record re-checks equality (nb_equal) and a mismatch halts the stage
amendment_3.e10_protocol: timing_nb_main (same 200 instances as timing_main) and timing_nb_scale (same as timing_scale), single process, 10 repetitions, median and IQR, JIT warm-up excluded; weight-map preparation and smoothing reported separately
amendment_3.e15_kinematic: differential-drive stop-and-turn model on the smoothed path: each segment driven with a trapezoidal profile (v_max 1 cell/s, a_max 0.5 cell/s^2), in-place rotation at each vertex with a trapezoidal profile (omega_max 1 rad/s, alpha_max 1 rad/s^2); energy proxy = m*v_peak^2 per segment + I*omega_peak^2 + 0.05*|theta| per turn + 0.1*m*L rolling term, m = 1, I = 0.5; metrics kin_time, kin_energy, kin_stops, kin_rot_rad
amendment_3.e15_scope: same maps and queries as main stage, point robot (rho = 0) and footprint rho = 0.5 with exact swept clearance; JPS only at rho = 0; model parameters are fixed a priori and not tuned; this is a simulation, not physical validation
amendment_3.e15_limitation: no dynamics, slip, localisation error or other AGVs; reported as simulation evidence only

amendment_4.footprint_r1: restores the rho = 1.0 radius of the original revision plan (E9), which the first protocol draft had silently replaced by 0.3/0.5; two variants: footprint_r1 uses the main diagonal query (reports infeasibility honestly), footprint_r1q selects per map the first random query whose endpoints have clearance >= 1.0 and that is feasible for Traditional A* under the swept model
amendment_4.timing_nb_movingai: compiled single-process timing on all 400 MovingAI queries, 10 repetitions, nb_equal checked per record
amendment_4.bridge: attribution ladder on the main-stage maps and queries (general eps 1.1, warehouse eps 1.3, beta 0.15 as in the submitted paper): L0 original code proposed_v3; L1 same semantics re-implemented (Bresenham LOS, endpoint-average cost, greedy LOS parent, no reopening, LOS-only smoothing); L2 exact supercover collision; L3 integrated segment cost; L4 cost-based parent choice; L5 reopening; L6 cost-monotone smoothing; L7 adaptive eps; L8 selected config (= Proposed); baselines B0 original Traditional A*, B1 revised Traditional A*; every path re-evaluated with the exact integrated cost
amendment_4.l0_l1_gap: diagnosed before launch on 80 instances: L0 and L1 differ only in heap tie-breaking and in stale-entry handling; with both switched to the original rules 80/80 match L0, with both switched to the new rules 80/80 match L1; the original code may expand a node from a stale heap entry whose g exceeds the stored g (possible because the direction penalty makes the key anchor-dependent), which overestimates successor costs; the L0 -> L1 step is reported as its own row rather than hidden
amendment_4.invariants: L1-L2 g equals endpoint chain cost; L3-L4 g equals integrated chain cost; L5-L8 and B1 integrated chain cost <= g and <= W*C*_8; L6-L8 smoothing never raises cost; any violation halts the stage

amendment_5.date: 2026-09-30, written before any simulation code or result exists
amendment_5.engine: MuJoCo 3.3.7 (pip wheel sha256 898ff5b28069b06ee654011b88fbde8633ec540a854f82f49cd0472fe9224b5c); 3.5.0 has no cp39 wheel and failed to build
amendment_5.scale: 1 grid cell = 1 m; each obstacle cell is a 1 x 1 x 1 m box; horizontally contiguous obstacle cells are merged into one box per row run; map border is a wall

vehicle.footprint: cylinder chassis of radius r_body, height 0.3 m
vehicle.drive: two powered wheels of radius 0.1 m on hinge joints at lateral offset 0.7*r_body, two frictionless caster spheres
vehicle.wheel_actuator: MuJoCo velocity servo, kv = 20, torque limit 10 N m per wheel

amendment_5.controller: identical for every method, fixed before any run: rotate in place until |heading error| < 0.05 rad using a trapezoidal yaw profile, then track the segment with a trapezoidal speed profile on remaining distance plus cross-track and heading feedback on yaw rate (k_ct = 1.5, k_h = 2.0); waypoint reached when along-track progress >= segment length - 0.05 m; goal reached when distance to goal < 0.2 m

path_sets.S0: kin stage, warehouse, rho = 0 paths (point-mass planning), simulated with r_body = 0.5; methods Traditional A*, Weighted A*, Theta*, Weighted Theta*, Proposed, JPS; tests the point-mass objection of R4-2
path_sets.S05: kin stage, warehouse, rho = 0.5 paths, r_body = 0.5; same methods without JPS
path_sets.S10: footprint_r1q warehouse paths re-planned with rho = 1.0 by the same code, r_body = 1.0; methods Traditional A*, Theta*, Weighted Theta*, Proposed; a re-planned path is used only if its length and cost equal the stored record within 1e-9, otherwise the stage halts

noise.localization: Gaussian on the pose seen by the controller, sigma_xy = 0.02 m, sigma_yaw = 0.01 rad, redrawn each control step
noise.actuation: multiplicative Gaussian on each wheel command, sigma = 0.05
noise.friction: wheel-floor friction drawn once per run from U[0.6, 1.0]
noise.seeds: 5 per path, seed = int(sha256(key|k))[:8] for k = 0..4

metrics: clean success (reached and no chassis-obstacle contact)
number of contact episodes and total contact time between vehicle and obstacle boxes
minimum measured clearance of the chassis centre to obstacles minus r_body
wheel energy = integral of sum |tau * omega| dt
mean and max cross-track error to the planned polyline
amendment_5.timeout: 3 * kin_time of the path (or its analytic profile for S10) + 30 s
defensive: NaN or |qvel| > 100 aborts the run and records error
seed 0 of every path is simulated twice and must match bit-for-bit, otherwise the stage halts
path, radius and endpoints are checked against the source record before simulation
unit tests against analytic motion (5 m straight trapezoid, 90 deg in-place turn) and a wall-contact test must pass before launch
amendment_5.budget_rule: fixed before the smoke test: if the estimated wall time at 8 processes exceeds 6 h, drop queries per map in the fixed order 4, 3, 2, 1 (keeping diag and 0) until it fits; if still too long reduce seeds from 5 to 3; all 100 maps are always kept
amendment_5.wording: reported as high-fidelity physics simulation, not physical validation; no sensor model, no real localization stack, no multi-vehicle interaction, parameters are typical values not calibrated on a real AGV
amendment_5.fix_after_unit_test: floor condim set to 1 so casters are frictionless (MuJoCo takes the max condim of a pair; default 3 made casters brake the vehicle, found when all analytic unit tests failed with the vehicle stationary); no vehicle, controller or noise parameter changed
amendment_5.budget_applied: smoke test (24 S0 paths, 144 sims, 8 procs, 90 s) gives 0.625 s wall per sim; full 42000 sims = 7.3 h > 6 h; dropping query 4 gives 6.1 h > 6 h; dropping query 3 gives 5.0 h; run uses queries diag,0,1,2 with 5 seeds on all 100 maps; S10 unaffected (one query per map)

amendment_6.date: 2026-09-30, written before any test-set or simulation metric was computed

e15_sensitivity.source: kin stage paths (path_sm), all envs, rho 0 and 0.5, all methods present there
e15_sensitivity.design: one-at-a-time around nominal (v_max 1.0, a_max 0.5, w_max 1.0, aw_max 1.0): v_max in {0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0}; a_max in {0.25,0.5,1.0}; w_max=aw_max in {0.5,1.0,2.0}
e15_sensitivity.report: for each setting, paired difference Proposed minus each baseline (mean, 95% cluster bootstrap CI, Holm-adjusted p within family=(env,rho,setting,metric)); robustness = whether the sign and significance of the nominal comparison is preserved

analysis_rules.primary_reference: Proposed; every other method is compared to it; Traditional A* comparisons also reported for the percentage reductions
analysis_rules.timing_sources: only timing_main, timing_scale (single-process python) and timing_nb_* (compiled); t_search from parallel stages is never reported
analysis_rules.mjsim_unit: per path, average the 5 seeds for continuous metrics; reached/clean as fraction of 5 seeds; paired by (map, query) across methods within each set
analysis_rules.failed_or_missing: an instance enters a paired comparison only if both methods succeeded; the number excluded is reported
analysis_rules.tables: all LaTeX tables generated by script from jsonl, no hand transcription; best value per column marked bold, second underlined
analysis_rules.no_post_hoc: no metric, family, test or subset is added or removed after results are seen; any extra analysis is labelled exploratory

amendment_7.date: 2026-09-30, written AFTER the main-stage test results were inspected
amendment_7.decision: option A chosen by the author: the primary method stays the locked adaptive configuration (eps_max=1.3, beta=0.05); no method is re-selected on test data
amendment_7.fixed_eps: Proposed (fixed eps) is reported only in the ablation and labelled post hoc exploratory; it is not a main result
amendment_7.test_disagreement: decided after inspection, conservative direction only: a comparison is called significant only if both Holm-adjusted paired t and Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p < 0.05; otherwise reported as not significant with both p values shown
amendment_7.adaptive_eps: reported as a negative finding on the test set
